podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Collaborations with Notables
podcast.body: The group has collaborated with significant figures in rock and metal, such as Travis Barker of Blink 182 and Corey Taylor of Slipknot, on their songs. "And guys like Blink wanted to use Travis Barker, and Slipknot's Corey Taylor have worked on songs with him."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Corey Taylor Collaboration
podcast.body: Ho99o9 is a band that garnered enough admiration from Slipknot's Corey Taylor for him to appear on at least one of their singles, showcasing their appeal to figures in heavy music. "Then there's the band Horror. Corey Taylor is Slipknot, like them enough, to appear in at least one single."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres

podcast.title: Extensive Opening Slots
podcast.body: Ho99o9 has opened for a diverse range of prominent bands, including Avenged Sevenfold, Korn, Alice in Chains, Three Days Grace, and Prophets of Rage. "Horror has opened up for a Venge 7-fold, corn, Alice and Chains, three days grace, profits of rage and more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Heavy and Out-There Sound
podcast.body: Over the years, Ho99o9 has cultivated a distinctive sound that is described as "really out there," offering a heaviness comparable to what Nine Inch Nails can provide. "Over the years, they've developed a sound that can be really out there with the heaviest 9-inch nails can offer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Newark, New Jersey Origins
podcast.body: Ho99o9 (spelled with a '9' in place of 'R's) is a punk rap group originating from Newark, New Jersey, known for a similar stylistic approach to Rage Against the Machine. "This is a punk rap group from Newark, New Jersey. They're very much into the same headspace as Rage, two guys, the OGM and Yeti 999."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Reputation for Wild Live Shows
podcast.body: The band is known for staging "pretty wild shows," contributing to their unique reputation. "They also have a reputation of staging some pretty wild shows."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Shared Influences
podcast.body: The two members, TheOGM and Yeti999, met by attending basement punk shows and shared a common appreciation for hardcore music, hip-hop, and horror movies, particularly those directed by Rob Zombie, which inspired their band's formation. "They met going to basement punk shows. They both loved hardcore and they loved hip-hop. They both loved horror movies, especially those directed by Rob Zombie, so why not form a band?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Travis Barker Production
podcast.body: Travis Barker of Blink-182 has produced some of Ho99o9's songs, indicating the band's cross-genre appeal and production quality. "And Travis Barker of Blink 182 is produced some of their songs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
